title: Urban Development Verbs: kiépül, átalakul, létrejön

sections.title: Verbs with Prefixes of Completion in Urban History
sections.content: You know verbal prefixes from A1 Unit 28 and A2 Unit 22. Three verbs with prefixes describe a changing city: *kiépül* ('is built out'), *átalakul* ('is transformed') and *létrejön* ('comes into being'): *kiépült a sugárút* ('the avenue was built out'), *a főváros nagyvárossá alakult át* ('the capital was transformed into a large city'), *létrejött az egységes Budapest* ('unified Budapest came into being'). In a neutral sentence the prefix stands right before the verb.

items.spanish: Néhány évtized alatt kiépült a Duna két partján egy modern metropolisz.
items.english: Within a few decades, a modern metropolis was built out on both banks of the Danube.
